supersession_reason: V6 was rejected on the fresh 335000000 selection family because nominal safe success was 435/576 (75.52%) despite passing overall, violation, gain, uncertainty, temporary, and held-out gates. Development on that opened family isolated the fixed 36-step defer as an off-distribution low-level handoff. V7 permits the identical confidence-calibrated router used by each method to release defer when it confirms nominal; observed later events remain revisable. A declared controller screen selected V19 seed 1788, which achieved 167/192 (86.98%) nominal safe successes with evidence release and 893/960 (93.02%) over all conditions in the causal development run.
research_question: Can calibrated causal evidence release unnecessary defer while retaining temporal held-out recovery composition under matched observations and policies?

representation.name: complete_current_centered_causal_motion
representation.definition: At each decision, subtract the current 57-D task geometry from every geometry frame in the causal prefix; the final geometry is identically zero for every method.
representation.runtime_causality: Uses only stored observations at or before the current decision.

defer_policy.release_rule: Release defer when the method's calibrated posterior confirms nominal option 0; a later observed event may revise nominal or hand off irreversibly to a specialist.

shared_option_controller.matching_rule: The exact checkpoint is shared by causal, static, unstructured, heuristic, and oracle routers.

readme_release_rule: Promote the primary V7 result only if every primary, OOD, external, seed-count, and anti-shortcut criterion passes on untouched 340000000. An A/A+ general-method claim additionally requires the external PegInsertion closed-loop gate.
